rationale: Kshitij brings deep expertise in semiconductor IP verification (AXI, I3C, SystemVerilog) at NVIDIA, while Kazumasa's materials science background at Resonac and Sony spans semiconductor development—creating natural complementarity between verification engineering and materials innovation. As spectators at this event, both work in adjacent layers of semiconductor advancement and could explore how design verification challenges map to materials-level constraints.
intro_message: Kshitij Gupta, meet Kazumasa Marumo — you both work on semiconductor fundamentals from different angles (verification vs. materials science) and might find value in comparing how protocol verification and materials development intersect.
